title: feat(service-messaging): a keyed inbox notification reads in the reader's language, not the language it was delivered in
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEgmYCUeNPVYcGByE5Kd4DZ)_

Fixes #32240

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：站内信（`sys_inbox_message`）投递时除了渲染好的标题和正文，再存一份生成它们的翻译键和参数（新的只读字段 `keyed_text`）；读取时按读者请求的语言用同一个渲染器重新渲染标题和正文。内联投递和发件箱投递两条路径都存。
- 为什么改：没有保存个人语言的账号（例如 showcase 管理员）在中文控制台里看到的审批等通知标题一直是英文，因为标题在投递时按"用户语言，否则部署默认语言"冻结了。所有走站内信的通知都受影响。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个只读字段和一个读中间件，不改任何权限或已有字段；旧行没有键，原样返回（不回填）；读不出键、没有 i18n 服务、读者语言没有该条目时都退回存储的文本。回滚即还原本 PR，已写入的 `keyed_text` 列留着无害。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/inbox-reader-locale.ts`（中间件，注意投影补列与删列那段），`src/inbox-channel.ts`（只从 `n.keyedText` 取键、模板路径不存），`src/messaging-service.ts` 的 `renderedFor`（内联路径带上键）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts -t "READER"`，预期 6 例通过：同一行中文读者读到「订单已发货」，英文读者读到 "Order shipped"。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Seat ruling: option A from the card (store the keys on `sys_inbox_message`, render at read). Option B (join to the delivery snapshot) was not taken.

- **Where the keys were lost (measured on `origin/main` d391babc).** The durable path kept them only in `sys_notification_delivery.payload.keyedText`; the inline fan-out (`MessagingService.fanOut` → `renderedFor`) handed the channel a `Notification` whose `payload` is the producer's own `EmitInput.payload`, so no keys reached `inbox-channel.ts` at all. On both paths the inbox wrote only the rendered `title` / `body_md`.
- **`Notification.keyedText`** (`channel.ts`): an optional member, the keys the unit's `title` / `body` were rendered from. Set by the service on the inline path (also when no renderer is composed) and by the dispatcher from the validated snapshot (`readNotificationTextKeys`). Never read from `payload`, so a producer's free-form `payload.keyedText` is never taken as keys. Absent on digest deliveries.
- **`sys_inbox_message.keyed_text`** (`objects/inbox-message.object.ts`): `Field.json`, `readonly: true`, keys and params only. The `mine` list view names its columns, so the field is not shown there. The inbox channel writes it when the unit carries keys and the delivery is not on the template path (that text is the template's). A literal-only delivery leaves it unwritten, so its insert is byte-identical to before. Members already cannot create or edit this object (`allowCreate: false, allowEdit: false`), and the static `readonly` adds the field-level lock.
- **Reader-locale middleware** (`inbox-reader-locale.ts`, installed by `MessagingServicePlugin.init` on the `objectql` engine): on `find` / `findOne` whose `ExecutionContext.locale` is set, re-renders `title` and `body_md` from the stored keys. The seam is the delivery renderer itself: a new `NotificationTextRenderer.renderForReader(keys, literal, locale)`, the same `renderWith` path (one negotiation rule via `resolveBundleLocale`, `II18nService.t()`, per-member fallback to the stored text), without the "literal text was delivered" miss warning, because nothing is delivered on a read. The sequence is the one `plugin-audit`'s `sys_activity` summary middleware runs; no code was copied from it (service-messaging does not depend on plugin-audit). An explicit projection naming `title` or `body_md` but not `keyed_text` gets the column added for the render and removed from the served row.
- **Stays as stored:** rows without keys (all rows written before this change; no backfill), a read with no locale (every system read), no `i18n` service, keys that do not parse, and each member the reader's locale has no entry for.
- **Translations:** the new field's label and help regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` and hand-translated in all ten non-English locales, then `--write` again so no echo row remains (`check:i18n` in sync).

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing harness `keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` over better-sqlite3, the real service, inbox channel, SQL outbox and dispatcher). The recipient `u_none` has no saved locale and the deployment default is `en`, the showcase admin's case:

- inline fan-out: the row is stored in English with `keyed_text` equal to the emitted keys; a `zh-CN` reader reads 「订单已发货 / 您的订单 O_7 已发出。」, an `en` reader the English, a bare `zh` reader the Chinese, a read with no locale the stored English;
- durable path (SQL outbox + dispatcher tick): same;
- a row without keys reads its stored text in `zh-CN`;
- a producer `payload.keyedText` on the inline path is never stored as the row's keys;
- a projection of `title` alone gets the rendered title and no `keyed_text` column;
- `ja-JP` (no message entries in the catalog) is served the stored text.

Plus `messaging-service-plugin.test.ts`: the plugin registers exactly one middleware on `sys_inbox_message`, and it renders a stored row with the `i18n` service the plugin resolves.

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs on committed HEAD; restore verified blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

1. Middleware: `localizeInboxRow(row, renderer, locale);` replaced with a no-op. 4 failed / 49 passed: the plugin pin, inline, durable and projection cases (`expected [ { title: 'Order shipped', … } ] to deeply equal [ { title: '订单已发货', … } ]`).
2. Inline-path key storage: `renderedFor` returned without `keyedText: keys`. 2 failed / 25 passed: the inline case (`AssertionError: expected null to deeply equal { …(3) }` on the stored keys) and the projection case; the durable case stayed green, so the two paths are pinned separately.
3. Negative pin, keys taken from the producer's payload: inbox channel wrote `n.keyedText ?? payload.keyedText`. 1 failed: "a producer payload member named keyedText is never stored as the row's keys".
4. Negative pin, an unrequested column served: the `delete row[keyed_text]` after an added projection removed. 6 failed (every reader case reads an extra `keyed_text` member).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `/api/v1/notifications` (`MessagingService.listInbox`, the REST door) reads as the system with no locale, so its titles stay the stored text. The Console bell and Home inbox read `sys_inbox_message` through the data API, which carries the request locale, so they are localized. Threading a locale into the REST door needs `InboxQuery` (`packages/spec`) and `runtime/src/domains/notifications.ts`, outside this card's file surface. Noted, not filed.
- Digest rows (`processDigestGroup`) compose several notifications into one body and store no keys; they read as stored.
- No producer change: `plugin-approvals` already passes `keyedText`.

## Verification

All readings on head `254d67bc` (branch merged with `origin/main` bb472154; no overlap with this diff), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a rebuild of the i18n gate's closure.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`: 69 files, 883 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0. (Under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.)
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 10 hand-written `.ts` files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` then `pnpm check:i18n`: exit 0, service-messaging in sync (21 bundles).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 72 families, every one exit 0. Two first exited 3 (prerequisite, not a finding): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on the shallow clone (exit 0, 48 cases, after fetching its pinned fixture commit 621a4876) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 0 after building the packages it named with no `dist/`). `--ran`: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Dogfood battery: not run (no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm).
- CI check-runs: pending at open.
